tools.name: shiftavo_get_account
tools.description: Gets the company's tenant settings (one record). Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /account/ (scope account.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_list_locations
tools.description: Lists the company's locations. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /locations/ (scope locations.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_location
tools.description: Gets one location by id. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /locations/{id}/ (scope locations.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_list_positions
tools.description: Lists job positions (roles) with their skill expectations. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /positions/ (scope positions.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_list_employees
tools.description: Lists employees with their roles, status and locations. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /employees/ (scope employees.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_employee
tools.description: Gets one employee by id. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /employees/{id}/ (scope employees.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_list_shifts
tools.description: Lists published and draft shifts in a date-time range, optionally by location or position. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /shifts/ (scope shifts.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_shift
tools.description: Gets one shift by id, with its publication state. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /shifts/{id}/ (scope shifts.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_shift_assignments
tools.description: Gets the assignments of one shift. Use scope 'eligible' for the employees who may take it. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /shifts/{id}/assignments/ (scope shifts.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_list_timesheets
tools.description: Lists timesheets (clock-in and clock-out records) by employee, date and status. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /timesheets/ (scope timesheets.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_timesheet_breaks
tools.description: Gets the breaks of one timesheet. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /timesheets/{id}/breaks/ (scope timesheets.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_labor_cost
tools.description: Gets the labor-cost projection for a date range, optionally for some locations. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /labor_cost/ (scope labor_cost.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_get_time_account_balances
tools.description: Gets the working-time and night-work credit balances of one employee. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /time_account/balances/ (scope time_account.read).

tools.name: shiftavo_list_swaps
tools.description: Lists shift swap offers, optionally by status. Read-only. Shiftavo API: GET /swaps/ (scope swaps.read).
